'''SK Super Nova''' is a [[Latvia]]n professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Riga]]. It was founded in 2000, and it has been involved in various levels of the [[Latvian football league system]], including the top-tier [[Latvian Higher League]] and lower divisions. The team was based in [[Salaspils]] from 2022 till the end of 2023 season and returned to Riga in 2024."}}
